capabilities: Download web pages to Markdown notes
Sync bookmarks from Pocket and Instapaper accounts
Map notes to web pages and keep them in sync
Archive bookmarks from the corresponding notes
Schedule automatic syncing via a synch frontmatter attribute
extras: README notes the plugin works well for syncing shared whiteboards like Arc browser's easel and reading sites like Medium offline.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to store offsite copies of web pages or pull in bookmarks from read-it-later services.

relations.evidence: authorize the plugin to access either your Pocket or Instapaper Library
integrate with read-it-later services like Pocket and Instapaper

summary: Web page archiver that saves pages as Markdown notes and syncs with read-it-later services like Pocket and Instapaper.
